sources.title: VertexAIco/amethyst-1-mini · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Amethyst 1 Mini is a general-purpose chat and instruction-following model, fine-tuned from Gemma 3 4B IT using LoRA on a small, high-quality distilled instruction dataset. It is the first model in the Amethyst family — an early, small-scale release focused on validating an end-to-end distillation → fine-tune → evaluate pipeline on consumer hardware.
